title: Degree-one derived classes classify short exact extensions
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $P,Q\in\mathcal A$. Sending a short exact sequence $0\to P\xrightarrow{u}B\xrightarrow{v}Q\to0$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] to its connecting morphism $Q[0]\to P[0][1]$ is a bijection from isomorphism classes of such sequences to $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(Q,P)$ [def-pc-ext]. Here two sequences are isomorphic precisely when there is an isomorphism $h:B\to B'$ satisfying $h\circ u=u'$ and $v'\circ h=v$, so that the endpoint maps are identities. For any exact additive functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ to another abelian category with derived category, the class of the image short exact sequence is the image of its class under the termwise derived functor $D(F)$.

source.place: Tag 06XV, lemma-ext-1; Tag 06XU, lemma-yoneda-extension, with degree-one equivalence of extensions. Exact-functor compatibility follows by applying the termwise exact functor to the single-complex triangle; Mathlib Ext.mapExactFunctor_extClass covers this compatibility alone.
